## How I tested it
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run i18n:check && npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test` against a local instance
- [ ] UI changes checked in English and Chinese

## Checklist
- [ ] New UI text uses `t("...")` and has a Chinese translation
- [ ] Database changes are a new additive migration (no edits to existing migrations)
- [ ] No company-specific names, domains or real data
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
